title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From silent reading rooms to high-tech collaborative labs, Bentley University offers a range of environments tailored for business-focused research and group projects.

cards.title: Silent Study Zones
cards.subtitle: Bentley Library, Main and Upper Levels
cards.notes: Head to the back reading rooms on the main and upper floors for a strictly silent environment. Silence all devices and use headphones to maintain the quiet atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: Designated silent areas located in the back reading rooms of the library's main and upper levels.
cards.evidence_claim: The library designates the back reading rooms on the main and upper levels as Silent Study Zones where almost no noise is expected.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; specific zones are marked with red signage for silence.

cards.title: Collaborative Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Bentley Library, All Levels
cards.notes: Reserve one of 22 rooms online via the EMS system for group work. Most rooms feature LCD displays that connect to laptops for shared viewing.
cards.short_summary: Tech-equipped rooms for group collaboration, reservable by students for up to two hours per day.
cards.evidence_claim: Bentley Library offers 22 collaborative study spaces across three levels, most featuring LCD displays or SMART boards, reservable via EMS.
cards.access_notes: Reservations required via EMS; 15-minute check-in window applies.

cards.title: The Bubble
cards.subtitle: Student Center, Third Floor
cards.notes: Study at large tables or high-tops in this lively third-floor space. It offers a view of the living room below and is ideal for those who prefer background noise.
cards.short_summary: A popular, high-energy study area on the third floor of the Student Center overlooking the main lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bubble is a designated study area on the third floor of the Student Center featuring large tables and high-top seating.
cards.source_title: My Favorite Study Spots on Campus
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center hours; no reservation required for open seating.

cards.title: Deloitte Café
cards.subtitle: Bentley Library, Main Level
cards.notes: Grab a bagel and find a seat in this collaborative zone. It is a social study spot where conversation is welcome and food is easily accessible.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative study area located within the library's main level cafe, allowing for conversation and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: The Deloitte Café (Einstein's) is located on the main level of the library and is designated as a Collaborative Study Zone.
cards.access_notes: Open during library and cafe operating hours.

cards.title: Morison Study Nooks
cards.subtitle: Morison Hall, End of Hallway
cards.notes: Look for the orange chairs at the end of the hallway past the CMT. These nooks offer a quiet, secluded alternative to the main campus hubs.
cards.short_summary: Quiet, lesser-known study alcoves featuring distinctive orange seating located in Morison Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Morison Hall contains study nooks with orange chairs at the end of the hallways that are noted for being quiet and less crowded.
cards.source_title: Best Hidden Places to Study Around Campus

cards.title: Adamian Study Room
cards.subtitle: Adamian Academic Center, Near Parking Lots
cards.notes: Find this room at the end of the building for a space with comfortable chairs and large tables. It benefits from significant natural light and low foot traffic.
cards.short_summary: A bright and quiet study room located at the edge of the Adamian Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Adamian Academic Center features a small study room at the end of the building known for natural light and a quiet atmosphere.
cards.source_title: Best Hidden Places to Study Around Campus
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; typically used for individual or small group work.

cards.title: LaCava Center Booths
cards.subtitle: LaCava Center, Dining Area
cards.notes: Utilize the booths in LaCava for a mix of dining and studying. These spots include power outlets, making them convenient for long sessions between classes.
cards.short_summary: Dining booths equipped with power outlets, suitable for casual studying and meals.
cards.evidence_claim: LaCava Center features booths with outlets that students use for studying between classes.
cards.source_title: My Favorite Study Spots on Campus
cards.access_notes: Available during LaCava Center operating hours.

cards.title: Smith ATC Collaboratory
cards.subtitle: Smith Academic Technology Center
cards.notes: Work in small groups at stations featuring 50-inch displays and PC setups. These rooms are designed specifically for technology-infused collaborative learning.
cards.short_summary: High-tech group workstations in the Smith Center designed for collaborative digital projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smith Academic Technology Center houses collaboratory classrooms (e.g., Smith 210, 212) with 6-person workstations and 50-inch displays.
cards.access_notes: Available for student use when not reserved for classes.

cards.title: The Bowles Room
cards.subtitle: Bentley Library, Lower Level
cards.notes: Study among a collection of 2,600 volumes in this lower-level room. It is designated as a Quiet Study Zone, allowing for light ambient noise.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study room on the library's lower level housing a specialized book collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bowles Room on the lower level of the library is a designated Quiet Study Zone and houses a donated collection of 2,600 volumes.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; designated as an orange Quiet Study Zone.

cards.title: Jennison Active Learning Spaces
cards.subtitle: Jennison Hall, Multiple Floors
cards.notes: Use the mobile tablet desks on casters to quickly configure a group study setup. These renovated spaces offer a modern, bright environment for academic work.
cards.short_summary: Modernized classrooms in Jennison Hall with flexible furniture for group or individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: Jennison Hall features active learning classrooms equipped with tablet desks on casters for easy mobility and group setup.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours when classes are not in session.
